title: Some 130 IDF rescuers flew to Brazil after a dam collapse in Brumadinho and searched for the missing in the mud

trailer.text: According to the Jerusalem Post, the IDF Home Front Command's Search and Rescue Brigade was accepted in November as a member of the UN's International Search and Rescue Advisory Group.
According to the IDF website, a dam in the city of Brumadinho in Brazil collapsed in January 2019, and hundreds of people were missing.
According to the Jerusalem Post, Prime Minister Netanyahu spoke with Brazilian President Bolsonaro and agreed to send a delegation and rescue equipment within 24 hours.
According to the Times of Israel, some 130 Israeli soldiers, conscripts and reservists, took off for Brazil on Sunday morning to search for the missing.
According to JNS, the soldiers located at least 20 bodies and found no survivors.

glance.label: Who
glance.value: The IDF, the Home Front Command and ZAKA

paragraphs.text: According to the Times of Israel, the dam sent millions of tons of sludge downstream and covered the city.
According to the Times of Israel, the dam was at a mining site operated by the Brazilian mining company Vale.
According to the Times of Israel and Vale, many of the victims were company employees, hundreds of whom were working in the area at the time of the collapse.
According to Jewish News, on Sunday morning a second dam was reported to be at risk of breaking.
According to Vale's website, the failure of Dam I at the Córrego do Feijão mine occurred on January 25, 2019.

stations.title: A phone call on Saturday, a plane on Sunday

paragraphs.text: According to the Times of Israel, preparations for the trip began on Saturday, following a conversation between Prime Minister Netanyahu and Brazilian President Bolsonaro.
According to the IDF website, the IDF sent the delegation in accordance with Israeli Government directives and in close coordination with the Brazilian Government.
According to the Jerusalem Post, Col. (res.) Golan Vach conducted a situational assessment just before boarding the plane.
According to the Times of Israel, the plane was a chartered El Al airplane, and it took off from Ben Gurion Airport on Sunday morning.
According to the Times of Israel, this appeared to be the first-ever Israeli aid delegation to Brazil.
According to the IDF website, the delegation included engineering experts, doctors, search and rescue teams and firefighters from the Israel Fire and Rescue Services.
According to the Jerusalem Post, Foreign Ministry representatives, Israeli Ambassador to Brazil Yossi Shelly and ZAKA personnel also joined it.

According to the ZAKA chairman, the organization is a UN-recognized international volunteer organization, and it considers it a moral obligation to help anyone in need, regardless of religion, race or creed.
According to a Jerusalem Post editorial, this was the Home Front Command Search and Rescue Brigade's first mission as a member of the UN group.
According to JNS, the governor of Minas Gerais, Romeu Zema, greeted the delegation at the Belo Horizonte airport.
According to a ZAKA statement, the site could be reached only by helicopters provided by the Brazilian army.
According to an IDF statement, after a situational assessment and talks with local officials, it emerged that search and rescue was the main need at the site.
According to Ynetnews, the Israelis were the only foreign search and rescue delegation that assisted the Brazilian military.
According to the Jerusalem Post, the delegation brought 16 tons of equipment, including a mobile signal localization system, submarine sonar, voice and echo detectors, and drones.
According to ynet, the drones and a device that picks up signals from buried phones were used to mark the muddy area.
According to the Jerusalem Post, ZAKA brought a sonar device that the organization had recently purchased.
According to ynet, six teams of female soldiers from the Oketz unit, with dogs that specialize in locating bodies, searched the area.
According to Ynetnews, the Israelis worked mainly at four locations: a restaurant with at least 140 diners, a bus with at least 40 passengers, a minibus and a hostel.
According to Lt. Col. Sagi Baruch, Israel had never had a rescue mission in mud like this.
According to ynet, some of the bodies were found 3–4 meters deep in the ground.
According to Ynetnews, an army psychologist accompanied the soldiers and talked with them every evening, to help them cope with the sights of destruction and death.
According to ynet, two officers found a gold cross pendant in the mud bearing the name of a missing woman, who was found dead nearby.
According to JNS, the soldiers located at least 20 bodies, found no survivors, and were expected to return home within 48 hours.
According to Golan Vach, the team was aided by flies, dogs and human creativity.
According to the Times of Israel, Bolsonaro appeared to thank the IDF on Twitter for the delegation.
According to the Jerusalem Post, his son Eduardo Bolsonaro wrote that Israel does this because it is a friendly country.
According to Jewish News, Bolsonaro highlighted the Israeli aid in the local media and on social media.
According to Lt. Col. Baruch, local residents greatly appreciated the delegation's work.
According to the ZAKA chairman, the emergency services in Brazil gave the delegation excellent feedback on its professionalism.
According to Jewish News, Jewish communities in Rio, Belo Horizonte and Sao Paulo mobilized to gather donations for the victims and to help the Israelis who came to work.
According to the Jerusalem Post, in the year since the disaster the IDF sent delegations to Brazil two more times.
According to Golan Vach, this was the beginning of great cooperation between the two countries.

stations.title: What went wrong, and who is responsible

paragraphs.text: According to a Channel 13 News report, the delegation brought equipment that was unsuited to local conditions.
According to JNS, the soldiers found no survivors.
According to delegation member Alon Ominer, some said the delegation was political, but he does not see it that way.
According to Israel Hayom, Governor Zema said all the permits at the mining complex were in order and it was unclear what caused the collapse of the dam, which had been inactive for years.
According to Israel Hayom, the German auditor TUV SUD said it had inspected the dam in September and found it to be operating well.
According to Israel Hayom, Vale's CEO apologized without taking responsibility.
According to prosecutors in Brazil, three Vale employees and two engineers working on its behalf were arrested.
According to the judge's decision, investigators issued five arrest warrants and seven search warrants on suspicion of murder, falsification of documents and environmental crimes.
According to the Jerusalem Post, Brazil's top prosecutor said the company should be criminally prosecuted and executives held personally responsible.
According to the Times of Israel, environmental groups and activists said the disaster showed a lack of regulation.
According to the Jerusalem Post a year later, the official death toll stood at 259, and firefighters were still searching for the bodies of 11 missing people.

disagreements.question: How many people died in the disaster?

versions.says: IDF website, according to Brazilian authorities: at least 34
Times of Israel, according to Brazilian officials: at least 37
Jerusalem Post and Jewish News: at least 40
JNS: at least 58, and the number is rising
Jerusalem Post a year later: 259, official figure

disagreements.question: How many people were in the delegation?

versions.says: Times of Israel: some 130 soldiers, conscripts and reservists
Jerusalem Post: about 130 in active service plus 70 reservists
JNS: more than 100 Home Front Command soldiers

disagreements.question: Where in Brazil is the dam?

versions.says: Times of Israel: in the country's southwest
Ynetnews: on Monday, some 60 hours after the collapse

claims.quote: Brazil's top prosecutor said the company should be criminally prosecuted and executives held personally responsible.

claims.text: לפי טיימס אוף ישראל, ארגוני סביבה ופעילים אמרו שהדליפה האחרונה מדגישה היעדר רגולציה.
claims.quote: Environmental groups and activists said the latest spill underscored a lack of regulation.

claims.text: לפי ג'רוזלם פוסט שנה לאחר מכן, מספר ההרוגים הרשמי הוא 259, וכבאים עדיין מחפשים גופות של 11 נעדרים.
claims.quote: While the official death toll is 259, firefighters are still picking through the dried mud for the bodies of 11 people

claims.text: לפי אתר צה"ל, בהתאם לרשויות ברזיל לפחות 34 בני אדם מתו ומאות עדיין נעדרים.
claims.quote: According to Brazilian authorities, at least 34 people have died and hundreds are still missing.

claims.text: לפי ישראל היום ומכבי האש של מינאס ז'ראיס, לפחות 34 אושרו כהרוגים וכ-250 נותרו נעדרים ביום ראשון.
claims.quote: At least 34 people have been confirmed killed. Some 250 people were still missing as of Sunday, according to the Minas Gerais fire department.

claims.text: לפי טיימס אוף ישראל ובהתאם לגורמים ברזילאיים, לפחות 37 בני אדם אושרו כהרוגים ומאות נוספים נעדרים ומוערכים כמתים.
claims.quote: At least 37 people have been confirmed killed by the dam burst, with hundreds more still unaccounted for and presumed dead

claims.text: לפי ג'רוזלם פוסט, משלחת צה"ל יצאה לברזיל לאחר קריסת סכר שהרג לפחות 40 והותיר לפחות 200 נעדרים.
claims.quote: An IDF delegation took off for Brazil to help with rescue efforts following the collapse of a dam that killed at least 40 and left at least 200 missing.

claims.text: לפי ג'ואיש ניוז, לפחות 40 בני אדם מתו ועד 300 נעדרים בבוץ ובפסולת הכרייה.
claims.quote: At least 40 are dead and up to 300 missing amid the mud and mine waste that has buried everything for miles around the mine.

claims.text: לפי JNS, לפחות 58 בני אדם אושרו כהרוגים באסון, והמספר נראה כגדל.
claims.quote: At least 58 people have been confirmed dead in the disaster, though the number seems to be growing.

claims.text: לפי ג'רוזלם פוסט, על פי כבאים 65 מקרי מוות אושרו עד כה.
claims.quote: So far, 65 deaths have been confirmed, according to firefighters.

claims.text: לפי ynetnews, חיילי צה"ל איתרו לפחות 20 גופות בשכונות המוצפות בבוץ בברומדיניו, כשמעל 270 עדיין נעדרים.
claims.quote: have recovered at least 20 bodies from the mud-filled neighborhoods of Brumadinho after a dam collapse killed at least 84 people, with over 270 still missing.

claims.text: לפי ג'רוזלם פוסט, 279 עובדים, קבלנים ותושבים נוספים נעדרים ומוערכים כמתים.
claims.quote: Another 279 employees, contractors and residents are missing and presumed dead.

claims.text: לפי ג'רוזלם פוסט, המשלחת כוללת כ-130 חיילים וקצינים בשירות סדיר ו-70 מילואימניקים מפיקוד העורף, ובהם מומחי הנדסה, רופאים, אנשי חיפוש והצלה ולוחמי אש.
claims.quote: The delegation includes about 130 soldiers and officers in active service as well as 70 reservists from the Home Front Command, among them engineering experts, doctors, search and rescue personnel and firefighters.

claims.text: לפי ynet, המשלחת, שמונה כ-100 חברים, איתרה עד כה כ-20 גופות שנקברו תחת הבוץ.
claims.quote: עד כה איתרה המשלחת, שמונה כ-100 חברים, כ-20 גופות שנקברו תחת הבוץ

claims.text: לפי ג'רוזלם פוסט, הטיסה מישראל לברזיל ארכה 15 שעות.
claims.quote: After the 15-hour-long flight from Israel to Brazil and then to the site itself

claims.text: לפי JNS, המשלחת נחתה בטיסת אל על שכורה בברזיל מאוחר ביום ראשון כדי להצטרף לצוותי חילוץ מקומיים.
claims.quote: landed on a specially chartered emergency El Al flight in South Western Brazil late Sunday to join local rescue crews in the search for hundreds of people

claims.text: לפי ynetnews, יותר מ-100 חיילים ישראלים מפיקוד העורף ואחרים הגיעו לברזיל ביום שני, כ-60 שעות לאחר הקריסה.
claims.quote: More than 100 Israeli soldiers from the Home Front Command and other personnel arrived in Brazil on Monday—some 60 hours after the collapse

claims.text: לפי אתר חברת וייל, הכשל בסכר I במכרה קורגו דו פייז'אאו התרחש ב-25 בינואר 2019.
claims.quote: The failure of Dam I at the Córrego do Feijão mine on January 25, 2019 resulted in irreparable loss of life and suffering.

sources.label: IDF website, IDF Aid Mission to Brazil
Jerusalem Post, opinion article Rescue Nation, 2019
ynet, documentation of the IDF delegation to Brazil, 2019

quote_translations.c45: In this task, the Israeli teams are using drones and a device for detecting cellular signals from mobile devices that are buried in the ground.
quote_translations.c46: Afterward, six teams of female soldiers from the Oketz unit, with their dogs that specialize in locating bodies in rubble or underground, scan the area.
quote_translations.c48: Some of the bodies were found in poor condition at a depth of 3-4 meters in the ground.
quote_translations.c47: Two of them found a gold cross pendant among the clods of mud, with the name of a missing woman who was found dead nearby.
quote_translations.c44: So far the delegation, which numbers about 100 members, has located about 20 bodies that were buried under the mud
